sourceReviewSummary: Source: SUSD 2026–27 Instructional Calendar, 180-Day Schedule. Board approved December 16, 2025; district file updated April 10, 2026; last checked by MySchoolDates July 19, 2026.
sourceReviewDetails: We compared the first and last student days, four major break ranges, holidays, grading-period dates, and teacher professional development or other non-contact days with the official PDF.
The official 2026–27 calendars page lists a separate instructional calendar for Stockton Early College Academy (SECA). This page does not apply that SECA calendar to the districtwide dates.
The downloadable .ics file is generated from the dates shown here and is a one-time import, not a live district sync.

calendarFaqs.q: Which Stockton Unified calendar does this page use?
calendarFaqs.a: This page summarizes SUSD’s districtwide 2026–27 Instructional Calendar, 180-Day Schedule. It covers the main student attendance calendar rather than every school or program calendar.

calendarFaqs.q: Does Stockton Early College Academy use the same calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: No. SUSD lists a separate instructional calendar for Stockton Early College Academy (SECA). SECA families should use the school’s official calendar before making plans.

calendarFaqs.q: When do students return after Winter Break?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break ends Friday, January 1, 2027. The next regular school day is Monday, January 4.

calendarFaqs.q: Are teacher professional development days school days for students?
calendarFaqs.a: No. Dates labeled Teacher Professional Development/Other Non-Contact Day on the official schedule are not student attendance days.

calendarFaqs.q: Does the calendar download update automatically?
calendarFaqs.a: No. The .ics file is a one-time import for Google Calendar, Apple Calendar, or Outlook. Check the official SUSD calendar page for later revisions.

calendarFaqs.q: Where can I check for SUSD calendar revisions?
calendarFaqs.a: Use SUSD’s official 2026–27 calendars page and your school’s announcements. MySchoolDates is an independent reference and is not affiliated with Stockton Unified.

customSections.label: Which Calendar Does This Page Cover?
customSections.content: This page summarizes SUSD’s districtwide 180-day instructional calendar. Stockton Early College Academy (SECA) has a separate instructional calendar, so SECA families should confirm dates on the district’s official 2026–27 calendars page.

customSections.label: Midweek No-School Days
customSections.content: These four Wednesday no-school days fall outside the major break weeks and are easy to miss when arranging childcare or appointments.

customSections.label: What Changed From 2025–26?
customSections.content: The overall pattern changes only slightly from 2025–26. Each major break starts one day earlier in the month, school starts one day earlier, and the last day moves from May 28 to May 26.
